messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhmr copyFiles parameter
parts:
What this does is:

if in the R code you create a file and save it in "./tmp/", and copyFiles is TRUE, then all these files will be copied to the job output folder.

e.g.

map = expression({
for(a in map.values) {
  pdf(sprintf("tmp/%s.pdf",taskid))
  plot(runif(100))
dev.off()
}
}

And copyfiles=TRUE, then at end of job there will be many pdf files ...


On Sat, Feb 16, 2013 at 5:25 AM, kul <kuldee...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I may be overlooking something, but the doc for rhmr says 

copyFiles: Will the files created in the R code e.g. PDF output, be
          copied to the destination folder, ‘ofolder’?

What does files created in R means? I was looking at the first example http://www.datadr.org/doc/airline.html where data is downloaded for 22 years. I dont understand how you track a file created in R using a system command which can be anything from wget to touch. Nor do i see a parameter like copyFrom or something like that. Can you please clarify this?

Thanks much!
